description: Insert a project item at a timeline position, ripple QE sync-locked tracks to match Premiere's insert, and verify Premiere added no unexpected same-track fragments. Pass scope 'target_tracks' to ripple only the named pair (this will desync other tracks).

audio_track_index.description: Audio track index for the audio portion (default: 0)

item_id.description: Node ID or name of the project item to add

scope.description: Which tracks shift: 'sync_locked' (default) matches Premiere's insert; 'target_tracks' ripples only the named pair and WILL desync other tracks.

start_seconds.description: Start time in seconds on the timeline (default: 0)

name: add_to_timeline

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Add To Timeline
